QuestInfo.name: The Autograph Ticket Hunt
QuestInfo.0: Enin is a huge fan of Blake. She's very excited to meet Blake in person, but you have a feeling that something will go wrong...
QuestInfo.1: Enin was spreading the word about the autograph event, but she ended up losing her own ticket. Tragic! Get her another ticket to the event. Supposedly the Cherry Bubble Teas have been selling tickets on the side...
QuestInfo.2: You scratched off the Autograph Ticket Coupon, but you didn't win any tickets. Aww.

0.0: Oh no, what do I do!? I lost the ticket for the autograph event! I must have lost it while I was spreading the word about the event. NOoooooooOoOoO! How am I supposed to meet my hero without a ticket?
0.1: Who knows when Blake will host another autograph event... Or IF he ever will? Okay, can't cry... Gotta find a ticket somehow... Sniff... Could you maybe help me out? I don't think I can find one on my own.

yes.0: You're an angel! Okay, could you quickly hunt some #rCherry Bubble Teas#k and find some Autograph Ticket Coupons? #b40#k should be enough to get a winning one.

no.0: NooOoOo! I REALLY wanted his autograph. Please help! Please please PLEASE!

1.0: Excellent. Okay, let's scratch these coupons and see if we get a ticket!

yes.0: Not this one... Not this... No... Nope... Arrrrgh! All 40 of these were busts! Unbelievable!

item.0: Quickly hunt some #rCherry Bubble Teas#k and find some Autograph Ticket Coupons. 40 should be enough to get a winner.
